name: Secrets of an Angel
description: Cennet, who has been abused by her husband for years, calls Zeynep, the lawyer whose sign she sees from the window of her hospital room. He gives a letter to be opened after he dies. Zeynep's testament is this letter; It's actually a criminal complaint. After that day, the lives of Cennet's husband Yilmaz, and her children Birsen, Halil and Feride will change irreversibly.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Cennet, who has been subjected to violence by her husband for years, calls Zeynep, the lawyer whose sign she sees from the window of her hospital room. She gives a letter to be opened after she dies. This letter, which Zeynep thought was a testament; it is actually a criminal complaint. After that day, the lives of Cennet's husband Yılmaz, and her children Birsen, Halil and Feride will change irreversibly.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Everyone is shocked everyone when Cennet, who is resigned to her fate, leaves a letter and blames her husband for her death. But Yılmaz experiences the biggest surprise and disappointment. What happens between husband and wife is private, and revealing them is, in his opinion, is the greatest form of betrayal. Zeynep's goal is to find someone who can confirm what is written in the letter. Therefore, Birsen goes after Feride and Halil. The first person he reaches is Birsen, and it has been a obligation for Yılmaz to always keep Birsen at hand. Feride is already on her father's side. Only Halil remains. However, finding him is more difficult than Zeynep expected. After long efforts, Halil comes across a place he never expected.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Zeynep is shocked when she learns that it was Cennet's son, Halil Tekin, who battered her car. The situation is no different for Halil. While waiting for Caner, he found Zeynep in front of him. Moreover, the young woman is her mother's lawyer. Halil, who read the letter of Cennet; Unlike Birsen and Feride, he admits that his mother has been subjected to violence throughout her life. But this, in his opinion, is a belated move. And now this doesn't help anyone. He tells Zeynep to stop pursuing this. He will do the same, and he will move on with his life. However, a new information he learns from his sister causes Halil to question himself. On the other hand, Zeynep, who is desperately looking for a clue, receives a phone call from someone she never expected.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Zeynep, who hopes to find a clue about Cennet's death, even if it's small, cannot get an answer to any of her questions. One of the two people who were there that morning had his tongue silenced, and Yılmaz was determined not to speak. On the other hand, Halil, who came to the neighborhood for Zeynep, meets his father once again after the funeral. While they share their trump cards, Birsen is again spent. As if this were not enough, Birsen fell down the stairs and was taken to the hospital. While everyone thinks that this is an accident, Halil, who learns the truth, makes a big decision that will change everyone's life, especially himself.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Learning that it was Seray who unleashed Halil on him, Yılmaz warns Birsen for the last time. Either she will hold her daughter's bridle tight or she will not look the same in her next mistake. On the other hand, Halil ignites the war between him and his father by holding the opposite house. Knowing very well that the grass is trampled while the elephants are fighting, Birsen refuses to take a side in this war for her children. Feride, on the other hand, has still not been able to find a lawyer, and the excuses she gave to her father have been exhausted. As a last resort, she has to call Caner. While this meeting causes great confrontations, the hidden secrets are also revealed. However, the real big secret is hidden inside one of the bundles that Cennet left for her three children.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Feride, who refuses to see the violence inflicted on her mother and siblings, embarks on a journey towards her childhood with the bloody food left to her by Cennet. This journey brings her to a detached house. On the other hand, Halil, who learns that the case will be closed due to lack of evidence, wants to talk to his brothers once again. The three brothers meet in the house where they hid years ago after escaping from Yılmaz. The days they lived in the house determined the future of all four, and nothing was the same again. While a showdown is taking place in which everyone is pouring the stones on their skirts, Feride makes a decision that determines their future as she did years ago.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Yılmaz's joy, who thinks that he will get away with what he has done with the closing of the case, turns into a nightmare the moment he hears Cennet's voice. The woman, who remained silent about the violence she had seen for years, reneged on the promise she made to her husband when she was getting married and, in Yılmaz's words, "laid mines everywhere before going to death". On the other hand, Birsen's confession inflames Halil's anger even more. But it is the message that his mother left him on the day he died, who broke the ties. During his childhood; Halil, who is trying to make his voice heard and to have the doors his father closed on them, is determined this time to destroy the terrible man standing on the threshold. Whatever the cost, he will do it.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Yılmaz, who was taken to the courthouse to be interviewed, fell ill and was taken to the hospital before he appeared before the prosecutor. While hoping to be arrested, Halil finds himself in the hospital waiting for his father to recover, torn between anger and pity. On the other hand, he and Zeynep get closer. This causes Funda to be jealous of the duo. She offers Caner a cooperation to get revenge. Thus, the opportunity that Caner was looking for came to his feet. In this way, he will be able to keep Zeynep away from Halil. As part of the plan, he organizes a birthday party for Zeynep in Soso. The gift he gives at the end of the night carries Halil and Zeynep to an irreversible point. While all this is going on, a surprise witness emerges that will change the course of the case.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Watching the images of Halil with Funda, Zeynep is very disappointed and decides to stay away from Halil. For this reason, he includes Caner in Cennet's case. However, this move does not stop Halil and further increases the interaction between them. For Armağan, who has been against his daughter's meeting with Halil from the beginning, this is an unacceptable friendship. When she came to her office to tell Zeynep about this, with a person she never expected; Ali meets Fuat. Kıvanç, who learns that Feride is pregnant, thinks that he has to make a decision about his marriage, but Feride makes that decision and signs the divorce protocol. On the other hand, Halil goes crazy when he learns that Yılmaz was released in self-defense and that the blood in the house may belong to his father. In order for the case to continue and for the grave to be opened, new evidence is needed. This evidence comes to Halil from a person he never expected, when he least expects it.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Feride's sudden discomfort ties Zeynep, who wants to clarify the issue of Yemen. At least until the danger of miscarriage passes, he has to postpone the pressure he puts on Kıvanç and Feride. On the other hand, Yılmaz, who is determined to take Birsen home, continues to seduce Yusuf. While talking about morality and honor, he mentions İlker's name in between. When Yusuf comes home, he learns that his sister has called the hairdresser home, and he walks against Seray. Although Birsen, who has never seen Yusuf like that before, is worried, she cannot even imagine the magnitude of the danger that is coming. After receiving an unexpected invitation from Kıvanç, Halil and Birsen go to Feride. That night will be both a night of reckoning and a new opportunity for reconciliation for the three brothers. Yılmaz's sudden arrival turns all plans upside down. The paths of the three brothers diverge again. For Halil, who has no branches to hold on to, the only place to take refuge is Paradise.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Halil, who saved Ali Fuat's life, is injured and taken to the hospital. There are two women at his bedside, one of whom Halil loves and the other one who loves Halil. Thanks to this painful event, Zeynep confronts her true feelings and starts to think again about her relationship with Halil. With the news of Halil's injury, fire falls on Birsen's house. Yılmaz, who learns that Halil was shot by the police, does not move. On the other hand, Ali Fuat unconditionally accepts Halil, who disregards his life for someone he does not know, as his son. While waiting for Halil's good news at the hospital, a package is sent to Birsen's house by Kıvanç. It contains the Yemeni, the only evidence of murder. Kıvanç wants them to decide as a family what to do with Feride. Thus, a court is established in Halil's house.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Putting himself out to save Feride, Yılmaz falls silent after demanding that the tomb be opened. For Halil and Birsen, who know that they will get up with a handful of earth from where their father fell, this is the silence before the storm. Yılmaz, acting with the logic of “one of us and one of you”, sets his sights on Yusuf, the weakest link in the family. Feride, who was saved thanks to Yılmaz, starts to live with the cameras installed in each room. Kıvanç is now aware of his wife's step. With Feride Kıvanç's suggestion, who could not meet with her father, she started to write a letter to Yılmaz. However, this is not a casual offer. On the front of Zeynep and Halil, the two lovers, whose love has surrounded the chimney, step into a happy union despite everyone. On the other hand, Cem is terrified when he learns that Ali Fuat has already confronted Zeynep. Ali Fuat, who confronts Cem, says he wants his daughter back.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: Yilmaz, who stabbed Mehmet by trapping Yusuf, manages to keep Birsen and the children with him by hiding the murder weapon. However, this means the beginning of tormented days for Seray. The beating that Seray took the first night she entered the house is a harbinger of what will happen next. Birsen, on the other hand, could not prevent his father and also drove Halil out of the house, who knocked on the door, so that a bigger incident would not occur. Involuntarily, his mother started to cover up violence like Cennet. This situation encourages Yılmaz even more. The early decision to open a grave causes Halil to question his decision. On the other hand, Levent organizes a meeting for the whole family to put emotional pressure on Halil. Hours before the autopsy, Halil is alone with the responsibility of this big decision. What Zeynep is afraid of is all about their relationship. If the autopsy results do not turn out as they wanted, he doubts that Halil can continue his life as before.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: Disappointed with his father's innocence, Halil leaves the Heart End and returns to his old lost days. No one but Funda can reach him. Ali Fuat comes to the aid of Zeynep, who is looking for Halil everywhere. He warns Halil not to upset Zeynep any more. Feride, who escaped from the house after the report came out clean, defies her husband, who came after her with the provocation of her father. However, Kıvanç makes an unexpected move and forces him to make a choice by saying "either me or your father". On the other hand, a woman named Kader enters Yılmaz's life unexpectedly. This woman, whom Yılmaz met by a sweet coincidence, will bring many surprises with him. Zeynep, who makes a sudden visit to the place where Halil is, is shocked by what she sees.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: Learning that Halil is threatened by Sefer, Ali Fuat is forced to admit that he is Zeynep's real father. He did not dare to appear in front of Zeynep as a murderer, and he planned to be closer to her by using the inheritance case as an excuse. But now her daughter's life is in danger. The next day, he dismisses Zeynep without thinking and withdraws the case. Halil keeps his promise to Ali Fuat and returns to the Heart's End. But nothing is as he left it. Yusuf almost became a copy of his grandfather, and Seray, who was not allowed to go to the classroom, was almost imprisoned in the house. Halil has no choice but to stand up and start over. As if all of this wasn't enough, İlker, who was invited to the house within Yılmaz's plan, aspires to Birsen. On the other hand, Zeynep, who learns by chance that Halil has returned home, feels deceived. Everyone else knows that he is back. His second disappointment is when he learns that Ali Fuat has withdrawn the case.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: When Halil learns that Ali Fuat has fallen victim to slander, he begins to look at him from a different perspective. A father-son relationship is established between the two over time. Halil also accepts Ali Fuat's job offer because he wants to gain Zeynep's trust and show that he is permanent in the Heart End. Now his only goal is to convince Zeynep of this. By calling İlker home and disgracing Birsen in front of his children, Yılmaz achieves his goal. Birsen says with his own mouth that he will stay at his father's house. Seray, who clings to the possibility of her mother leaving that house one day, is greatly disappointed, while Yusuf accuses his mother of betraying his deceased father. Feride, who is exposed to her father's manipulation, wants to use her pregnancy to chase Kıvanç, but cannot find what she hoped for. It goes to Yilmaz's ear that Ali Fuat and Halil will be partners. He is jealous of the father-son relationship established between them.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: Yilmaz, who brings Ali Fuat's thread to the market, humiliates Halil in front of his family and kicks him out of the house. Everyone is in shock. No one can understand why Halil, who has bloody knives with his father for his mother, is partnered with a murderer. Meeting with Ali Fuat and Halil, Zeynep seeks answers to the questions in his mind. However, the heart of Ali Fuat, who had to lie by looking into his daughter's eyes, cannot withstand this pressure. He is hospitalized with a heart attack. While Zeynep secretly blames herself, Halil tells Zeynep to stop pursuing this. To Yılmaz, who was clapping after them in the euphoria of victory, A phone call comes in the same night. Destiny, who fell in the bathroom, could not make her voice heard, so she called Yılmaz as a last resort. Yılmaz, in a hurry, goes to help with Feride. The next day, Yilmaz, who takes Feride's car to take Kader to the outpatient clinic, has an accident, and everyone in the family is aware of Kader's existence.

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: Yilmaz has suffered a great injustice according to himself. Although he was acquitted, he could not explain himself to Kader. Although he is ambitious at first, Kader's absence starts to hurt more and more as the days pass. Seray, who wants to save the people at home from Yılmaz's pressure, shows her grandfather a way so that they can make peace again. Yilmaz listens to her and knocks on Kader's door again, asking her for another chance to introduce herself. Just like his father, Halil leaves the house of the woman he loves unpleasantly. Zeynep cannot digest the injustice of the man she loves and leaves the house. He spends the night working in his office. While Caner supports her research, Zeynep unknowingly moves towards her own truth step by step. On the other hand, Halil wakes up with Ali Fuat's message. Saying that he will not be there for a while, Ali Fuat entrusts Zeynep to Halil. While Halil cannot make sense of this untimely departure, he is shaken by a sad news.

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: After the funeral; Halil, who wants to forget his pain for a bit and fulfill his promise to Ali Fuat, works day and night to get the club ready for the opening. After the announcement of Ali Fuat's will, it is learned that all the inheritance belongs to Halil. Zeynep and Halil, who keep a distance from Halil because he hid the truth from himself, are strained again because of the will. Halil wants to pass all his father's wealth to Zeynep by marrying Zeynep, as Ali Fuat wishes. This is Ali Fuat's last request from him. Zeynep, on the other hand, rejects the property of a father whose surname she cannot take. Now, the most important obstacle in front of their marriage is this inheritance. While Yılmaz is dragging his daughter towards divorce step by step, he is also concerned about starting a new life with Kader. However, Kader has different plans for Yılmaz.

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: Halil and Zeynep listened to the audio recording that Kader left. Zeynep will inform Halil when the woman whom they do not know calls again. Halil wants to leave Zeynep at Cem and Armağan's house, he will ask them for the girl he loves. Zeynep does not accept because she is still offended by her family. Cem and Armağan do not know how to act against this marriage that they have never approved. Halil would like to have his brothers as well. Meanwhile, Feride's going with Kıvanç and not returning to her father's house infuriated Yılmaz. Yılmaz forces Feride to make the most difficult decision of her life. Halil learns new things from Ömer about the night Ali Fuat died. That night, Cem met Ali Fuat last. Halil asks Cem to go and tell him what happened. Cem is also very disturbed by Halil's accusatory attitude, which he does not like. While all this is going on, Caner is not sitting idle.

videos.title: Episode 21
videos.overview: Taking advantage of Yılmaz's confusion, Cem continues to lie that Ali Fuat confessed to the murder. Halil doesn't want Zeynep to have even the slightest doubt about Ali Fuat because of the lies that Cem skillfully told. Halil even willingly pushes Zeynep away. Because he will fulfill Ali Fuat's original will by undertaking the dangerous job that he has been thinking about for a while but did not dare to do. He will prove that Ali Fuat, the best father he knows, is not a murderer. The lies and slanders that Yılmaz and especially Cem told almost turned out to be good for his plan. Halil will hide the truth until the day comes. He will get closer to Sefer Göreli because he has the proof that Ali Fuat is innocent. Yilmaz marries Kader by having a lightning wedding. Birsen and Feride strongly oppose this marriage. Thus, a cold war begins between Kader and Birsen at home. Halil, who burned all the ships with this last evil done by Yılmaz, swears that he will bring his end.

videos.title: Episode 22
videos.overview: Halil conveys the partnership offer to Sefer Göreli. On his way to prove Ali Fuat's innocence, he encounters a shocking truth. The Göreli family know that Ali Fuat's daughter is alive and have been investigating who the girl is for a long time. Zeynep's life is in danger, Halil should not make the slightest mistake. Kader takes action for a plan that will bring the end of Yılmaz. Halil realizes that the person who sent the audio recording is Kader. Although Zeynep is very angry, she starts to act with Halil over the Kader case. Yilmaz, who sees Seray with a boyfriend from the classroom, goes mad with anger. Claiming that he has trampled her honor, she decides to marry her grandson. Birsen comes to a big crossroads, her father is about to inflict the same fate on Seray. caner, He tries to get closer to Zeynep by cooperating with Armağan just to hurt Halil. But Halil will never allow this.

videos.title: Episode 23
videos.overview: Halil's plans are turned upside down when the locals learn that Ali Fuat's daughter is alive. Halil's job is much more difficult now, he has two vital issues now. While trying to prove Fuat's innocence, Ali has to prevent the Relatives from being aware of Zeynep's existence. Worried for Zeynep's life, Halil will have to ask for the help of one of his worst enemies. As if all this weren't enough, he tries to find a way to completely distance Caner from Zeynep. Zeynep, on the other hand, focused on the issue of Destiny. Although she tries to stay away from Halil, the developments regarding Kader make it inevitable for the duo to reunite. Feride's demeanor, who cannot digest her father's marriage, causes Kıvanç to suspect her. Yılmaz increases his intense pressure on Birsen and Seray. For the first time in her life, Birsen goes against her father and has no intention of taking a step back.

videos.title: Episode 24
videos.overview: Birsen, who left his father's house and started to stand on his own feet, is living the happiest days of his life. But Yılmaz will do everything in his power to make her unhappy and regretful. Caner, who started working for Dündar, goes to Yılmaz to learn the truth about Halil, especially to find out who Salkım Göreli is. Of course, Yılmaz doesn't know who Salkım is, but he pretends to know Caner. Dundar is almost sure that Ali Fuat's daughter is Zeynep. Halil is aware of the trap he was drawn into, when he goes to Dündar, he sees that there are armed men waiting for him. If Halil cannot solve this issue, Zeynep's life will be in danger. He will protect Zeynep at the cost of his life. Yılmaz's mental health begins to deteriorate day by day. He is left alone and feels betrayed. Destiny takes action, thinking it's the best time for her plan. Zeynep and Halil are acting together to understand what Kader is trying to do.

videos.title: Episode 25
videos.overview: Zeynep, who learns about Halil's sacrifice, is as sad as his happiness. Because the facts he learned revealed the terrible lie of his father, Cem, one of the people he trusted most in life. Zeynep seeks Halil's support in order to realize one of the most difficult confrontations in her life. On the other hand, Dündar Göreli pressures Halil to give Salkım to him. Halil and Cem take action for their mind-blowing, dangerous plans to lure the suspicions over Zeynep. Feride, who is trying to prove Kader's true intentions to her father, follows Kader and sees him visiting Solmaz's grave. Kader asks Halil for help to prevent Feride from telling this information to Yılmaz. But Yılmaz will learn the truth in a surprising way. Learning that Kader is Solmaz's brother, Yilmaz He feels completely cornered by the effect of his delusions. According to him, the only way to get out of this deadlock is to end Kader's life.

videos.title: Episode 26
videos.overview: While Yılmaz was about to kill Kader, Halil caught up at the last moment and saved Kader's life. However, Yılmaz does not remember anything. The police take Yılmaz into custody for killing Kader. Halil's aim is not to have Yılmaz imprisoned for a murder he did not commit. He will reveal that Kader is alive. Thus, justice will be provided, and Yılmaz will only be punished for his crimes. However, for this to happen, Yılmaz has to accept that he cannot escape the murder of Kader under any circumstances. It will be difficult for Halil and Zeynep to reach their goals when Caner says that he has the evidence to take on Yılmaz's lawyer and save him. Caner tells Yılmaz that he will present his evidence to the court in exchange for one thing. When Feride comes to visit, Yılmaz tells her about her situation. Feride, as always, bows to her father's will. However, this path he took to help his father will also constitute the first steps of his change against his father.

videos.title: Episode 27
videos.overview: Yılmaz has been sent to prison. Yilmaz, who is completely cornered, begins to exert intense pressure on Feride. Birsen approaches her brother with love to save Feride from her father's poisonous influence. Feride starts to get confused about her father. Even though he still can't accept that his father is a bad man, he started to think and question. Halil, on the other hand, will get the image proving Ali Fuat's innocence from Saba no matter what; but what Saba asks him to do is too risky. Although Zeynep does not want the man she loves to take this risk, she cannot change Halil's mind. He takes action to find out what the evidence is that will enable Yılmaz to be tried pending trial. Destiny feels very lonely in the house where she is hiding. The intense pessimism that he was about to die from his illness soon settled over him. Halil, Zeynep, Birsen and Turgut do their best to make him feel like a part of the family. Meanwhile, Feride learns the fact that Kader is alive.

videos.title: Episode 28
videos.overview: Halil and Zeynep take action for their original plans. In the end, they will confront Yılmaz with the evil he has done.. Yılmaz tries every way to get out of this situation he's stuck in. He will get rid of this trouble and hurt Halil. Her only savior is Feride. If Feride goes to court and says "Destiny lives", Yilmaz will be saved. But Feride is no longer the Feride she knew. Yılmaz tries to seduce her daughter with evil plans. Meanwhile, Fate, in the grip of his terminal illness, worsens. Realizing this situation of hers, Halil does not hesitate for a moment to take Kader to the hospital. The fact that Kader's sister lives longer, even for one day, is much more valuable than Yılmaz's life imprisonment. Will it be revealed that Kader, whose illness worsens in the process where Yılmaz confesses his true crimes in court, is alive?
